note: Allow list of external data sources (CLAUDE.md, Data sources: D-53, D-62, D-63). A request to any host not listed under an enabled source is refused before any network use. Session 1 enables Azure Maps and OSM Overpass only; every other source stays disabled with no host until the session 2 discovery is approved. No source fills a mandatory start field.

azure_maps.license_note: Microsoft Azure Maps terms of use (imagery); the terms check was dropped by D-46

osm_overpass.license_note: OpenStreetMap data, ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors; Overpass API fair-use policy: small bounded queries, descriptive User-Agent

query_limits.note: queries are bounded by radius and by element count; CALIBRATION_PENDING until measured

osm_overpass.timeout_note: read timeout of the HTTP client in seconds; CALIBRATION_PENDING (was 25 s, which timed out on the first site of the recording run). Keep it above osm.query_timeout_s in config/site_understanding.json so the server answers or gives up before the client does
